data.text:
Maraming salamat, Chiba City, Japan!🚒

Malugod na tinanggap ng lokal na pamahalaan ng Quezon City ang mga fire truck na handog ng delegasyon mula sa Chiba City, Japan.

Dumalo sa turn-over ceremony sina acting Mayor Coun. Mikey Belmonte, acting Vice-Mayor Coun. Candy Medina, QC Fire District Director FSSupt. Rodrigo Reyes, QC General Services Department Head Ms. Fe Bass, QC Local Economic Investment and Promotions Office Head Mr. Jay Gatmaitan, at Office of the City Mayor External Relations Officer Tetta Tirona.

Kasama naman sa delegasyon mula sa Chiba City Local Fire Division sina Mr. Yasuo Kogo, Mr. Hiroshi Ishikawa, Mr. Kenji Nakajima, Mr. Hiroaki Kawamura, at Mr. Takeshi Mizoguchi.

Bahagi ito ng Resolution No. 9726 S-2024 sa pagitan ng QC Government at Chiba City Government na nilagdaan noong Hunyo ng nakaraang taon.
